instruction: Play any song released in 2021 from my Spotify album library.
notes: Single-app task. The album library is listed (nullary knowledge predicate), then an album in it is inspected to learn its songs, a song's release date is verified with show_song, and play_music is called with that song_id. The target song is modeled as a placeholder object song-2021-from-library whose membership in a library album and 2021 release are static init facts the agent discovers at runtime. supervisor-complete-task takes the played song as a non-API record parameter so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed. Evaluation only expects the MusicPlayer to be updated to playing a 2021 song from the library, so no other state change is modeled.
